reflectionQuestion: When you feel really tired, what helps you feel safe and cozy?
title: The Heart-Shaped Rock
theme: tiredness, feeling worn out, needing rest
reflectionText:
Lila was so tired she could barely hold her fork. But her father was there with warm water, a gentle comb, and clean sheets. He didn't rush her or ask her to do more. He just took care of her.

When we are worn out and weary, rest is a gift. And sometimes the people who tuck us in are the hands of God, holding us close at the end of a long day.
